blocks.text: The capital area major case squad shall be a police organization consisting of 13 area law enforcement agencies having the function of investigating major crimes in the area surrounding the City. (Ord. 20206 § 11, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 34-77. Code 1995 § 90-58. Formerly 2.120.060.)
